text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Switch EXCAVA to the distilled 32B variant. It’s the only model that clears the real-time bar—sub-30ms latency—while still delivering the required 0.5% quality gain, proven in the 1000-sample benchmark. The trade-off is accepting a smaller absolute quality jump than the 70B, but the 32B’s speed keeps the pipeline stable under load spikes.

name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t just latency—it’s benchmark drift. A 32B distilled model’s 0.5% gain could vanish if EXCAVA’s live task drifts, while a 70B’s extra margin buffers against prompt misalignment. Benchmark both against the 405B’s baseline at 5000 samples; if the 32B’s quality drops below 0.4%, default to the 70B.
